decisions.label: Backing darkness
decisions.note: How dark the patch under every sigil on the ground is (0: none, and no opaque sigil either: as #752).

decisions.label: Backing size (times the sigil)
decisions.note: How wide the dark patch is, times the sigil's own width.

decisions.label: Sigil opacity
decisions.note: How solid the sigil is painted over its patch, times how much it shows (a fresh rune, the ghost fainter).
